description: This file is a Java test class for integration testing loan transaction reversal and replay scenarios within the Apache Fineract platform. It contains setup code, multiple test cases (annotated with @Test), and helper methods to create loans, perform repayments, charge off loans, and validate journal entries and transaction states.

classes.name: LoanTransactionReverseReplayTest
classes.description: An integration test class extending BaseLoanIntegrationTest for testing loan transaction reversals and replays within the Apache Fineract platform.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes REST-assured, sets up request and response specifications, and initializes helper instances before each test.

methods.name: loanTransactionReverseReplayWithAdditionalInstallmentAndChargesTest
methods.description: Test case that covers creating a loan, disbursing, repaying, refunding, reversing, adding charges, and running COB to verify accruals and transaction effects.

methods.name: loanTransactionReverseReplayWithAdditionalInstallmentAndChargesScheduleDueDateTest
methods.description: Test case that manages repayments, reversals, chargebacks, and verifies schedule due dates after various transaction modifications.

methods.name: loanTransactionReverseReplayWithChargeOffAndCBR
methods.description: Test case to simulate charge-off, repayments, credit balance recharges, reversals, and journal entry validations for a loan.

methods.name: createLoanProduct
methods.description: Helper method to create a loan product for testing.

methods.name: createLoanAccount
methods.description: Helper method to create and approve a new loan account with specified parameters.
